name: Iraq-Jordan Gas Pipeline (Basra-Aqaba gas leg)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Iraq-Jordan Gas Pipeline; Basra-Aqaba twin pipeline (gas component); Rumaila-Aqaba gas pipeline

researcher_notes: MATCH CHECK: No Jordan-touching or Basra-Aqaba gas row exists in the 54-row Iraq gas roster (nearest are P7573 Basra-Ceyhan, to Turkey, and P0450 Iran-Iraq-Syria) so this is not an existing GEM gas row. The oil leg is tracked separately in GOIT (gem.wiki 'Basra-Aqaba Oil Pipeline'); this candidate is the distinct GGIT gas leg. ADD-THRESHOLD (all three met): (a) sponsor = Iraq Ministry of Oil + Jordan Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (state-to-state); (b) endpoints = Basra, Iraq -> Aqaba, Jordan; (c) concrete step = April 2013 intergovernmental agreement / framework for an ~$18bn TWIN oil-AND-gas pipeline, with Jordan's cabinet approving construction (2013) and Iraq's cabinet re-approving the twin oil+gas project in Feb 2018. CONFIRMED DATA: parallel gas line rated 350 MMcf/d within Iraq and 258 MMcf/d on the Jordanian stretch (258 used as Capacity value); twin-corridor length 1,680 km (~1,044 mi) — the gas line runs parallel to the oil line in the same corridor, so LengthKnown reflects the shared corridor length (no separate gas-only geometry published). Diameter, Owner, and a gas-specific cost were never disclosed (the $18bn was the combined twin figure) so left blank. STATUS = cancelled: the gas component was dropped in the 2017 downscoping to reduce cost and expedite the oil-only line (corroborated across AGSI and thenewregion analyses seen in search, and consistent with Bayan Center 2020 which reports only 'the oil pipeline project is continuing'); the gas leg was briefly revived in the Feb 2018 twin re-approval (Rudaw) but the project ultimately proceeded oil-only. GEM does track cancelled cross-border proposals (cf. P0450, P0481). CONFIDENCE: high — >=2 independent English outlets (UPI 2013, Pipeline Technology Journal, MEED, Rudaw 2018, Bayan Center 2020) agree on sponsors, endpoints, 258 MMcf/d gas, and 1,680 km, and are not reprints of one wire. ROUTE: no official GIS route for the gas line; Basra->Aqaba corridor only (route work out of scope, geometry belongs to the routes repo). Recommend ShelvedCancelledType handled at apply time (confirmed cancellation, not presumed).
